text.jpText: ちょ聞いてよ！　これから補習とかなくね？
text.enText:
Hey, got a moment? You know how I have 
supplementary lessons, like, now?

text.jpText:
いつメンから『ガチピンチ』って
連絡入ってんだよ？　ヤバくない！？
text.enText: Well, my besties just texted me, and they're in a pinch! Like, for real for real!

text.jpText:
だから～行ってあげなきゃっしょ！
『カラオケ100点取るまで帰れまてん』に！
text.enText:
So I have to go help them out, obvs! 
They can't go home 'til they score full 
points in karaoke!

text.jpText:
ってことで、代わりに補習よろた～ん☆
……ダメ？
text.enText:
So, like, you're cool to go study 
for me, right? Thaaanks!☆ …No?
